brief.claim: Spine density on hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons rises with the dose of the drug the animal received: the regression slope of spine density on dose is positive, and a test of the slope gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: spines per 10 micrometres of dendrite on each sampled neuron, in each histological section, of each animal
dose of the drug (mg/kg) that each animal received

brief.sizes: animals = 12; sections = 4; neurons = 25 (spine_density: 12 x 4 x 25 = 1200 values; dose: 12 values)
